pages.text: The pack adds 29 custom enchantments (24 general + 5 planetary from Ad Astra).$(br2)$(bold)Dimensional Survival:$() Heatward (fire/lava), Voidward (void damage), Depthstrider (pressure), Aether Acclimation (cold/height), Warp Shield (teleportation). Essential for T3+.$(br2)$(bold)Combat:$() Momentum (speed=damage), Adrenaline (low-HP boost), Titan Slayer (boss damage), Crowd Control (AoE slow), Adaptive (resist last damage type), Boss Ward, Steadfast, Nemesis, Last Stand.$(br2)$(bold)Resource:$() Prospector, Lumberjack, Reaping. $(bold)Path Synergy:$() Mana Temper, RF Capacitance, Convergence.$(br2)$(bold)Planetary (Ad Astra):$() 12% drop from planet mobs: Lunar Stride, Thermal Regulation, Pressure Shell, Void Adaptation, Stellar Shield.
